military_police.summary: ISIL abducted cadets from Camp Speicher in Tikrit. Executed 1,700+ Shia soldiers in mass killings. Bodies dumped in Tigris river and mass graves.
Two truck bombs struck US and French barracks in Beirut. Killed 241 American servicemen and 58 French paratroopers. Deadliest single day for US Marines since Iwo Jima.
LTTE suicide truck bomber hit a naval convoy in Sri Lanka. Killed over 100 sailors near Digampathana. Massive explosion injured 150 others.

government.summary: Al-Qaida truck bomb detonated at US Embassy in Nairobi, Kenya. Killed 213 Kenyans and 11 Americans. Simultaneous attack occurred in Tanzania.
Truck bomb destroyed Murrah Federal Building in Oklahoma City. Anti-government extremist killed 168 people. Deadliest act of domestic terrorism in US history.
Medellin Cartel truck bomb destroyed DAS headquarters in Bogota. Targeted Colombian intelligence agency during drug war. Killed 63 and injured 600.

business.summary: Al-Shabaab truck bomb exploded at busy Mogadishu intersection. Targeted Safari Hotel and nearby businesses. Deadliest bombing in Somalia's history.
Jemaah Islamiyah detonated bombs at Bali nightclubs. Killed 202 people, mostly foreign tourists. Targeted the Sari Club and Paddy's Pub.
Lashkar-e-Taiba gunmen attacked Mumbai hotels and landmarks. Siege on Taj Mahal Palace and Oberoi lasted days. Killed 166 civilians and security personnel.

citizens.summary: Hijacked planes struck the World Trade Center in New York. Both towers collapsed killing thousands of civilians. Deadliest terrorist attack in human history.
Chechen rebels seized a school in Beslan, Russia. Three-day siege ended in explosions and fire. Killed 334 hostages, including 186 children.
Boko Haram militants attacked Gamboru Ngala, Nigeria. Opened fire on busy market and burned town. Killed over 300 civilians in a 12-hour assault.

transportations.summary: Sikh extremists bombed Air India Flight 182 over the Atlantic. Plane disintegrated killing all 329 aboard. Remains Canada's largest mass murder.
Al-Qaida cell bombed four commuter trains in Madrid. Coordinated backpack bombs detonated during rush hour. Killed 193 and injured over 2,000.
Aum Shinrikyo released Sarin gas in Tokyo subway. Killed 14 people and injured thousands. First major chemical terror attack on modern transport.
